The University of Oxford Felix Scholarships is an opportunity offered by the University of Oxford to graduate students pursuing postgraduate studies. The scholarship aims to provide financial assistance to underprivileged students of India and to stimulate scholars by exposing them to academic study, cultures and experiences that would contribute to the culture and welfare of their home communities. The selected candidates will receive 100% of course fees, a grant for living costs (around GBP 18,300) and one return flight from India to the UK.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
hold a first-class undergraduate or master's degree from an Indian university
be willing to pursue a full-time master's course or DPhil course
not have previously studied the same course
A grant for living costs (around GBP 18,300)
One return flight from India to the UK

There is no separate application for the scholarship. Students who have applied for the eligible courses within the relevant deadline will be automatically considered for the scholarship.
The application timeline is the same as the respective course deadline. Please check the official university website for details.

Candidates will be selected based on merit and fulfilment of eligibility criteria as displayed on their admission application. Since there is no separate application for the scholarship, applicants are advised to check the relevant course deadline on the official university website. Selected candidates will be notified by the end of May.
The candidates are expected to return to India after completing their studies.
The students must submit their application for graduation before the deadline for the selected course.
The shortlisted students would be required to complete a short questionnaire before being invited for an interview.
To promote equality and authenticity, confidential information will not be shared by the authorities.
The candidates must ensure to fill correct details as it cannot be edited after submission of the application form.
Question: Where can I find all the eligible courses for this scholarship?
All the courses can be found on the course finder page on the official website of Oxford University.
Question: Are there extra benefits for disabled students?
No, there are no extra/separate benefits for disabled students.
Question: Is the living allowance a one time grant?
Please refer to the offer letter for details about the disbursement of the awards.
The scholarship is available for the entire duration of the selected course only.
Question: What is the mode of application?
Since there is no separate application process, students applying online for their courses will be automatically considered for the scholarship.
